tldr: Active exploitation of a WordPress core flaw and a now KEV-listed Zyxel switch zero-day headline a busy cycle, alongside fresh detail on the $6.3B Binance heist involving abused AI tooling, and a widening refrigeration-system attack campaign that has now disrupted blood storage facilities in France. 10 core items qualified today.

emerging.title: AI pipeline generates 948 Linux root-escalation exploits in 30 hours
emerging.description: An automated AI exploit-generation pipeline run against the Linux kernel produced hundreds of working root-escalation exploits in a day and a half — a striking leap in AI-assisted vulnerability discovery at scale. Single-sourced, unconfirmed by a second outlet.

emerging.title: Google: LLMjacking attacks rack up $1M+ in cloud AI charges
emerging.description: Attackers are using stolen cloud credentials to run unauthorized LLM inference workloads, billing victims over $1 million — a growing monetization vector as cloud AI use scales. Single-sourced, unconfirmed by a second outlet.

items.title: CISA confirms hackers exploiting WordPress core flaw during upgrades
items.description: CISA flagged a WordPress core RCE as actively exploited in the wild, with attacks occurring specifically during plugin/core upgrade windows. Patch immediately.

items.title: Zyxel zero-day exploited to hack nearly 1,000 network switches
items.description: A zero-day in Zyxel GS1900 switches (CVE-2026-7273) was used to compromise ~1,000 devices before a patch shipped; CISA has since added it to the KEV catalog.

items.title: Binance CEO: fake job interview and AI-tool abuse enabled $6.3B theft; North Korea denies
items.description: New detail emerged on the record-breaking Binance breach — a months-long campaign using a rigged coding assignment and abused AI tooling; Pyongyang denies involvement.

items.title: mSecure password manager breach prompts mass password/2FA/passkey reset
items.description: mSecure confirmed suspicious access to its systems and is urging all users to change passwords and reset 2FA and passkeys — high-risk given it's a password manager.

items.title: WorkOS says attacker used ARTEX AI tool to breach internal sales app
items.description: Developer-identity platform WorkOS disclosed a breach of an internal sales application, attributing the intrusion to abuse of the ARTEX AI tool; part of a wider wave of AI-linked breaches this week (also Northflank, Trigger.dev).

items.title: Refrigeration-system attack spreads to blood storage in France; new wave hits Sweden, Belgium, Estonia
items.description: The campaign against supermarket refrigeration controllers (Danfoss/Copeland/Dixell), first seen in France in October, widened Nov 2 to Sweden/Belgium/Estonia and has now disrupted blood-storage refrigeration in France.

items.title: Google dismantles XCPE botnet built from 1.3 million Android TV boxes
items.description: Google and partners took down a sprawling botnet that had turned 1.3 million Android TV set-top boxes into a residential-proxy network.

items.title: APT29-linked hackers hijack web analytics script to deliver iOS/Android zero-click exploits
items.description: A Russia-linked APT29 campaign compromised a widely embedded web analytics script to push n-day exploits into zero-click attacks against iOS and Android devices.

items.title: Russia dismantles VasyGrek cybercrime group, arrests three suspects
items.description: Russian police took down the infrastructure of the VasyGrek cybercrime group and detained three suspects, in a rare domestic enforcement action.

items.title: Hackers hijack cPGuard autoupdate in OpsShield supply-chain attack
items.description: Attackers compromised the cPGuard update mechanism to push a backdoor and exfiltrate data via a broader "OpsShield" supply-chain compromise.

action: Patch WordPress core now (actively exploited); apply the Zyxel GS1900 fix (newly KEV-listed); mSecure users should rotate passwords, 2FA, and passkeys without delay.
